summary: Coeur Mining filed an 8-K reporting progress under its expanded $750 million share repurchase program announced March 23, 2026. As of May 15, 2026, repurchases totaled 3,989,969 shares at an average price of $17.46/share ($69.7M), including ~3.18M shares at $18.91/share ($60.0M) in May 2026. $680.3M remains authorized. Repurchases are executed via open-market purchases under a 10b5-1 plan and a 10b-18 agreement with BMO Capital Markets. No board recommendation or advisors named. The filing discloses transactional mechanics (broker agreement, plan structure). What to watch: pace of future repurchases and impact on share count; risk-arb angle limited as this is a buyback, not a merger.
